description:
Bring the doctest substep under the per-test bound by keeping only rustdoc examples that clarify non-obvious behaviour.

## Background

The `cargo-ci` doctest substep runs 61 doctests in 4.4 s, 21% of the warm suite clock. The workspace is on edition 2021, so rustdoc compiles and links each doctest against the `jit` library separately. Most examples sit in `validation/engine.rs`, `output.rs`, `domain/item.rs`, `config.rs`, `graph/hierarchy.rs`, `domain/queries.rs`, `visualization.rs` and `repository_state/default_rules.rs` under `crates/jit/src`. `@/inv/essential-code-prose` admits an example only where it clarifies non-obvious behaviour, and `cargo-ci` fails when a doctest is ignored.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The doctest substep of `cargo-ci` takes under 5 s on a warm target at load ≤ 10, measured under the build turnstile.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each rustdoc example that is removed either restated a property a unit test owns, or its property gains a unit test.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each remaining example clarifies non-obvious behaviour, and none is ignored.

## Notes

Examples in feature-gated parser modules stay as they are.
title: Doctest substep fits within the per-test bound
